description: Count confirmed outings at a venue. Resolves aliases first; typed PlaceVisits are primary, and past non-todo events/GPS evidence for the canonical place are reconciled by day. count excludes plans, todos, and separately labelled reconstructed_candidates. Returns visit dates and evidence refs. ($0.10; API key required)

person_ids.description: Contact that must have been on the visit ids, e.g. ["3f2a1b4c-8d9e-6f01-c2b3-c4d5e6f70809"].

place.description: Venue name to count visits for, e.g. Ferry Building.

name: get_place_visits

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

inspect_note.description: How to cite: link each record with its inspect_url, never a link built from an id; which record types here have no Dayze page.

items.description: Unconfirmed completed-trip evidence with confidence and source; never included in count.
Ambiguous canonical place matches; count stays empty.
Confirmed same-day outing with visit_date and evidence_refs. A typed place_visits row is primary and carries visit_id (= id); linked event/GPS evidence is reconciled without increasing the count.

title: Place Visits
